slots.writingObjective: State as a fact about TextOS that it follows presence one question at a time and describes change without crediting it to a cause.
One sentence for a search result: TextOS tracks each buyer question over time and describes the observed change, with its comparability, never as proof of a cause.

Open on the reader's situation: they published something and want to know whether their presence in AI answers moved, but a single global number hides which questions changed and tempts everyone to claim credit. Say that the useful unit is the question.
slots.buyerIntent: How do I know whether anything moved?

slots.heading: How can I track how my presence evolves, question by question?
slots.writingObjective: Answer directly: TextOS makes the question the unit of result; it reads each question at fixed points after a publication (day 1, day 7, day 30) and keeps the question's history continuous; what it reports is an observed evolution with its comparability and uncertainty, never a cause.
slots.buyerIntent: How can I track how my presence evolves, question by question?

slots.heading: One timeline per question, kept intact
slots.writingObjective: Explain that each tracked question has its own timeline, that a new version of the question list does not break that timeline as long as the question keeps the same objective, and that a change of method, surface or language never produces a before/after difference: the timeline restarts instead. Say what that changes for a team reading the results.
slots.buyerIntent: Will my history survive when the question list changes?

slots.writingObjective: Caption the figure of this note in one or two factual sentences, grounded in the evidence it cites.

slots.heading: Day 1, day 7, day 30 mean exactly that
slots.writingObjective: Explain the fixed readings after a publication, that a reading taken a day early or late is never presented as the day-N reading but shown at its real delay, and that the thresholds behind these readings are fixed product rules, not settings chosen on screen. Say why strict dates matter to a buyer comparing weeks.

slots.heading: A before and after only when the windows match
slots.writingObjective: Explain the comparison rule: before and now are compared over equal windows, and only when both sides rest on the same, non-zero number of answers; otherwise there is no comparison. Add that every proportion carries its denominator rather than a bare percentage, and that an unproven value is shown as unknown rather than as zero.

slots.heading: What the tracking never claims
slots.writingObjective: Explain that no gain is credited to a piece of content, that the result describes an observed evolution with comparability and uncertainty, never causality; that scheduled checks never get ahead of or interfere with the customer's own reference measurement; that a scheduled check cannot be relaunched by hand because the relaunch would become the measurement of record; and that, while the work is still in progress, which readings an organization gets depends on its plan.
slots.buyerIntent: Will it tell me my article caused the change?

slots.heading: What to ask any AI visibility tracker
slots.writingObjective: Give the buyer a short list of questions to put to any vendor, one per sentence, drawn from the mechanisms this note describes. Recommendations only, no claim about TextOS.

slots.heading: Where to go next
slots.writingObjective: Point the reader to the related notes. No claim about TextOS.
